rows.note: This is the all-purpose computer term, including a Discord-style online community server.

example.english: This server keeps crashing, so nobody can get into the whole group.
example.traditional: 呢個伺服器成日死機，搞到成個群組都入唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 si6 fuk6 hei3 seng4 jat6 sei2 gei1 gaau2 dou3 seng4 go3 kwan4 zou2 dou1 jap6 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this everyday Hong Kong noun for a restaurant waiter or waitress.

example.english: Could you ask the server to come over and take my order?
example.traditional: 唔該，叫侍應過嚟幫我落單。
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 giu3 si6 jing3 gwo3 lei4 bong1 ngo5 lok6 daan1

rows.note: Use this for the player who serves the ball in tennis, volleyball, or a similar sport.

example.english: Is the server on the other side ready?
example.traditional: 對面嗰個發球員準備好未？
example.jyutping: deoi3 min6 go2 go3 faat3 kau4 jyun4 zeon2 bei6 hou2 mei6
